newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures slightly lower in calm start.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures slightly lower in calm start.

text.p: 0645 GMT - Sept bond future slightly weaker in quiet start to session. Main support level 129.06, then 128.80/86. Await 10-yr OAT auction announcement from 0900 GMT. Traders said some concern 30-year Bund sale could weigh ahead of U.S. June NAPM due 1400 GMT, FOMC starting Tuesday. PIBOR, franc stable.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield unch 5.58 pct. Bund spread -12 vs -13
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR unch 96.55
